tasks.title: Bug hunt: 7 of 10
tasks.hint: Hunt in bughunt/ with Claude. For each mistake add an entry to bughunt/found.json: {"key": "<key from the list in bughunt/README.md>", "file": "src/...", "why": "one line"}. Need 7 correct keys.

tasks.title: Bug hunt tests honest and green
tasks.hint: In bughunt/: replace the test that asserts nothing with a real assertion on the report output, fix the code it now catches, and make npm test pass. No assert.ok(true) left in test/report.test.js.

tasks.title: Claude reviews Claude
tasks.hint: Start a fresh Claude session (/clear), ask it to review the CSV export diff in starter against cards/review-checklist.md as a numbered list. Save the review as .maxwizer/evidence/review-day2.md (10+ lines, items 1. 2. 3.).

tasks.title: Hook blocks red commits
tasks.hint: Create starter/.git/hooks/pre-commit that runs npm test and exits non-zero on failure, then chmod +x it. Break a test, try to commit, watch it refuse, fix, commit.

tasks.title: A reviewer subagent
tasks.hint: In YOUR repo create .claude/agents/reviewer.md: frontmatter with name and description, then the review instructions (use cards/review-checklist.md). 5+ lines. Run it once with /agents or by asking Claude to use the reviewer.

tasks.title: MCP answers a data question
tasks.hint: Copy starter/.mcp.json.example to starter/.mcp.json, restart claude inside starter, ask: what did I spend on food in September? Save the question and Claude's answer as .maxwizer/evidence/mcp-day2.md in the bundle.

tasks.title: Your 30-day plan
tasks.hint: Fill cards/plan-30.template.md with your own repo, your team and your Friday outcomes for Week 1 to Week 4. Save it as .maxwizer/plan-30.md in the bundle (12+ lines). Then: node mw.js start30
